translations.translatedText: Food prices. Electricity prices. World population. Forest fires in Portugal. The weather.
The TV's Clear News has a summer break from 6.6. to 12.8.
Read and listen to the radio broadcast here.
## Food prices

![Outdoor cucumbers being preserved at Herkkumaa in Tuulos, Hämeenlinna.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4618,h_2593,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97965262c7ebe247e3a/1657269313)
Open image viewer
Food production is now more expensive than before. Photo: Timo Leponiemi / Yle

Food is becoming more expensive. Prices have already risen, and in the autumn food will become more expensive still. This is how the director of the Food Industry Federation, Mikko Käkelä, assesses it.

Käkelä says that food is becoming more expensive because Russia has attacked Ukraine. Because of the war, the prices of raw materials and the price of energy are rising. Food production is now more expensive than before.
There is even a shortage of raw materials around the world. For example grain is scarce, because Russia is preventing grain transports from Ukraine to the world.

Käkelä says that food companies must also pay more for transport than before. The reason is a shortage of drivers. There are few drivers, because Ukrainian drivers are fighting in the war against Russia.
## Electricity prices

![Red-brick hydropower plant on the Iijoki river, water and riverside bushes in the foreground.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1269,h_716,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-90787361f3d23335d38/1643369246)
Open image viewer
Hydropower must be saved for winter, because the water volume is now small. Photo: Risto Degerman / Yle
Electricity is also expensive now. Usually electricity gets cheaper in summer, but now the electricity price has not fallen.
The electricity price is high for many reasons. The electricity price rises because electricity is no longer brought to Finland from Russia.
In addition, the start-up of the new reactor at the Olkiluoto nuclear power plant, that is, the atomic power plant, has been delayed.
There are now also few water reservoirs in the Nordic countries. That is why hydropower must be saved for winter.
## World population

![People dressed in face masks in a crowd at a railway station.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8371566103e753143e8/1627646075)
Open image viewer
Soon we will be 8 billion. Photo: Yasuyoshi Chiba / AFP
There will soon be over 8 billion people in the world.
The UN, that is, the United Nations, estimates that there will be over 8 billion people already in November this year.
The UN also estimates that next year India will have the most residents. India will thus become the most populous country in the world.
The population also grows a lot in Africa, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Nigeria and Tanzania, and in Asia in the Philippines.
## Forest fires in Portugal
In Southern Europe, in Portugal, there are many forest fires. The fire spreads easily now, because the weather is hot and a dry wind blows in Portugal.
Over 3000 firefighters are putting out fires in the central and southern parts of Portugal.
Many people have been injured in the forest fires in Portugal.
## The weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12532487)
Open image viewer
The weather in Finland is warm and rainy. Between the Monday and Tuesday nights, a lot of rain may fall in the south.
The temperature on Tuesday is close to 25 degrees in a large part of the country. In the east the temperature rises even to 30 degrees.
On Wednesday the weather cools and hard rain and thunder showers come to Finland. It may rain a lot on Wednesday.
